R-Main covers established residential neighbourhoods including Basavanagudi, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, and Banashankari. Permissible uses are dwellings, apartments, parks, and neighbourhood civic amenities
Ancillary professional offices or neighbourhood retail up to 20 percent of built-up area or 50 sq.m (whichever is less) are permissible on roads of 12.0 m width and above in R-Main
Ancillary commercial uses in Residential (Main) zone are permissible only in Ring I and Ring II on plots up to 240 sq.m abutting roads of 12.0 m width or more
R-Mixed permits residential development alongside commercial and institutional uses subject to abutting road width thresholds under Table 10
in Residential (Mixed) zone [R-Mixed], standalone commercial buildings are permitted only where the abutting street has an existing clear width of 12.0 metres or more
C-Central covers high-intensity commercial cores in Ring I and Ring II with FAR from 2.50 to 3.00 and maximum ground coverage up to 75 percent
C-Business covers district commercial centres and sub-arterial commercial corridors in Ring II and Ring III with FAR from 1.75 to 3.25 based on road width
C-Mutation applies to plots abutting designated arterial and radial corridors up to a depth of 50 metres, permitting commercial and mixed-use development up to FAR 2.75 to 3.25
I-General permits light, medium, and service industries, warehousing, and logistics with ground coverage from 45 percent to 60 percent and FAR from 1.00 to 1.50
I-HiTech covers IT/BT corridors, electronics parks, R&D campuses, and support commercial/residential uses in Electronics City, Bommanahalli, and Bannerghatta corridors with FAR up to 3.25
P&SP covers government offices, educational institutions, hospitals, cultural centres, and civic utilities with ground coverage up to 45 percent and FAR from 1.50 to 2.50
T&T covers bus terminals, metro stations and depots, railway yards, and multi-modal transit facilities with FAR up to 1.50

T&T zone permits bus terminals, metro stations, depots, multi-level parking, telecommunication towers, and ancillary commercial/office transit-oriented development up to 25 percent of total built-up area with FAR up to 2.25

Park and Open Space zone permits only public parks, playgrounds, botanical gardens, and sports fields; ancillary sports/watchman structures shall not exceed 5 percent of site area at Ground plus 1 floor
Every residential layout exceeding 4,000 sq.m shall earmark at least 15 percent of total area for parks and open spaces and 10 percent for civic amenities
